name: LuxPrompter
subtitle: A private teleprompter camera source
description: Install and update LuxPrompter through AltStore Classic.

apps.name: LuxPrompter
apps.subtitle: Record on camera while reading your script.
apps.localizedDescription: A local-first camera teleprompter with adjustable text, scrolling speed, normal and Cinematic capture, and on-device video review.

versions.localizedDescription: Tap the prompter to play or pause, with smoother speed control near 100% and new ±1% buttons.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: LuxPrompter uses the camera to record your videos.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LuxPrompter records audio with your videos.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: LuxPrompter saves completed videos to your Photos library.
